```ts
function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

function coreInventory(ctx: Context): CoreInventoryService | undefined {
  return (ctx as unknown as { inventory?: CoreInventoryService }).inventory;
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(init?.headers ?? {}) },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = typeof data.error === "string" && data.error.length > 0 ? data.error : `请求失败 (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return data as T;
}

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {

  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {

    } catch (err) {

    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try {
    await promise;
  } finally {
    inflight = null;
  }
}

  async approveRequest(
    id: string,
    approver?: string,
  ): Promise<{ request: ApprovalRequestView; item: CoreInventoryItem }> {
    const row = this.requestRowById(id);
    if (!row) throw httpError(404, `审批单不存在: ${id}`);
    if (row.status !== "pending") {
      throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}，无法重复审批`);
    }
    const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
    if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用，无法执行出库");
    const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
    if (!item) throw httpError(404, `库存商品不存在: ${row.item_id}`);
    const quantity = Number(row.quantity);
    if (item.quantity < quantity) {
      throw httpError(
        409,
        `库存不足：${item.sku} 当前 ${item.quantity} 件，申请出库 ${quantity} 件`,
      );
    }
    const reason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
    const updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(quantity), reason);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const note =
      typeof approver === "string" && approver.trim().length > 0
        ? `审批人: ${approver.trim()}`
        : null;
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `UPDATE plg_inventory_approval__requests
         SET status = 'approved', note = ?, decided_at = ?, executed_quantity = ?, updated_at = ?
         WHERE id = ?`,
      )
      .run(note, now, quantity, now, id);
    return { request: this.toRequestView(this.requestRowById(id)!), item: updated };

private guardStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  try {
    const outboundQty = payload.delta < 0 ? Math.abs(Math.trunc(payload.delta)) : 0;
    const policy = this.getPolicy();
    if (outboundQty <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
    const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
    const approval = rawReason ? this.findRequestByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
    if (!rawReason) {
      this.recordAudit({... outcome: "blocked", source: "direct"});
      return `单次出库 ${outboundQty} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
    }
    if (!approval && rawReason.length < MIN_REASON_LENGTH) { ... } // maybe skip
    this.recordAudit({... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null});
    return undefined;
  } catch { return undefined; } // never break core
}
```

async approveRequest(id, approver?): Promise<{request, item}> {
  const row = this.rowById(id);
  if (!row) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (row.status !== "pending") throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}`);
  const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
  if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用");
  const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
  if (!item) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (item.quantity < row.quantity) throw httpError(409, `库存不足...`);
  const composedReason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
  let updated;
  try {
    updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(row.quantity), composedReason);
  } catch (error) { throw error; }
  // mark approved
  this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET status='approved', decided_at=?, updated_at=?, note=? WHERE id=?`).run(...)
  return { request: this.toRequestView(this.rowById(id)!), item: updated };
}

```ts
private beforeStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  const delta = Number(payload?.delta ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta >= 0) return undefined;
  const outbound = Math.abs(Math.trunc(delta));
  let policy: ApprovalPolicy;
  try { policy = this.getPolicy(); } catch { policy = { threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, updatedAt: "" }; }
  if (outbound <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
  const item = payload.item;
  const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
  const approval = rawReason ? this.findApprovalByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
  if (!rawReason) {
    this.recordAudit({ itemId: item.id, itemSku: item.sku, delta, outbound, threshold: policy.threshold, reason: null, outcome: "blocked", source: "direct", approvalId: null, approvalCode: null });
    return `单次出库 ${outbound} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
  }
  this.recordAudit({ ... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null, approvalCode: approval?.code ?? null });
  return undefined;
}

private findApprovalByReason(reason: string): { id: string; code: string; quantity: number; status: string } | undefined {
  const match = APPROVAL_CODE_PATTERN.exec(reason);
  if (!match) return undefined;
  const row = this.db.prepare(`SELECT id, code, quantity, status FROM plg_inventory_approval__requests WHERE code = ?`).get<...>(match[1]);
  if (!row) return undefined;
  return { id: row.id, code: row.code, quantity: Number(row.quantity), status: row.status };
}

updatePolicy:

```ts
updatePolicy(threshold: number): ApprovalPolicy {
  const value = Math.trunc(threshold);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw httpError(400, "Approval threshold must be a number");
  if (value < MIN_THRESHOLD || value > MAX_THRESHOLD) throw httpError(400, `Approval threshold must be between ${MIN_THRESHOLD} and ${MAX_THRESHOLD}`);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = this.db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM ... WHERE key='threshold'`).get<{key:string}>("threshold");
  if (existing) this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET value=?, updated_at=? WHERE key='threshold'`).run(String(value), now);
  else this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('threshold', ?, ?)`).run(String(value), now);
  return this.getPolicy();
}
```

  const itemId = typeof input.itemId === "string" ? input.itemId.trim() : "";

  const quantity = Math.trunc(input.quantity);

  const reason = typeof input.reason === "string" ? input.reason.trim() : "";
  if (!reason) throw httpError(400, "Approval reason is required");
  const policy = this.getPolicy();

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> { ...same as seeds... }

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try { await promise; } finally { inflight = null; }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY;
  const summary = state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY;
  const requests = state.overview?.requests ?? [];
  const audit = state.overview?.audit ?? [];
  return { policy, summary, requests, audit, loading: state.loading, error: state.error, reload };
}

```ts
function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

function coreInventory(ctx: Context): CoreInventoryService | undefined {
  return (ctx as unknown as { inventory?: CoreInventoryService }).inventory;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { Context } from "cordis";
import { useNavigate } from "@host/client-sdk";
import type {
  ApprovalAuditEntry,
  ApprovalOverview,
  ApprovalPolicy,
  ApprovalRequestView,
  ApprovalStatus,
  ApprovalSummary,
} from "./contract.d.ts";

interface InventoryItemSummary {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly sku: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly quantity: number;
  readonly unit: string;
}

interface InventoryListSlotProps {
  readonly items: readonly InventoryItemSummary[];
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

interface InventoryItemSlotProps {
  readonly item: InventoryItemSummary;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

const EMPTY_POLICY: ApprovalPolicy = { threshold: 50, updatedAt: null };

const EMPTY_SUMMARY: ApprovalSummary = {
  threshold: 50,
  pendingCount: 0,
  approvedCount: 0,
  rejectedCount: 0,
  blockedCount: 0,
  allowedCount: 0,
};

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(init?.headers ?? {}) },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = typeof data.error === "string" && data.error.length > 0 ? data.error : `请求失败 (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return data as T;
}

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try {
    await promise;
  } finally {
    inflight = null;
  }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    void refreshOverview();
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  return {
    policy: state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY,
    summary: state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY,
    requests: state.overview?.requests ?? [],
    audit: state.overview?.audit ?? [],
    loading: state.loading,
    error: state.error,
    reload,
  };
}

  async approveRequest(
    id: string,
    approver?: string,
  ): Promise<{ request: ApprovalRequestView; item: CoreInventoryItem }> {
    const row = this.requestRowById(id);
    if (!row) throw httpError(404, `审批单不存在: ${id}`);
    if (row.status !== "pending") {
      throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}，无法重复审批`);
    }
    const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
    if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用，无法执行出库");
    const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
    if (!item) throw httpError(404, `库存商品不存在: ${row.item_id}`);
    const quantity = Number(row.quantity);
    if (item.quantity < quantity) {
      throw httpError(
        409,
        `库存不足：${item.sku} 当前 ${item.quantity} 件，申请出库 ${quantity} 件`,
      );
    }
    const reason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
    const updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(quantity), reason);
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const note =
      typeof approver === "string" && approver.trim().length > 0
        ? `审批人: ${approver.trim()}`
        : null;
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `UPDATE plg_inventory_approval__requests
         SET status = 'approved', note = ?, decided_at = ?, executed_quantity = ?, updated_at = ?
         WHERE id = ?`,
      )
      .run(note, now, quantity, now, id);
    return { request: this.toRequestView(this.requestRowById(id)!), item: updated };
  }

private guardStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  try {
    const outboundQty = payload.delta < 0 ? Math.abs(Math.trunc(payload.delta)) : 0;
    const policy = this.getPolicy();
    if (outboundQty <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
    const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
    const approval = rawReason ? this.findRequestByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
    if (!rawReason) {
      this.recordAudit({... outcome: "blocked", source: "direct"});
      return `单次出库 ${outboundQty} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
    }
    if (!approval && rawReason.length < MIN_REASON_LENGTH) { ... } // maybe skip
    this.recordAudit({... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null});
    return undefined;
  } catch { return undefined; } // never break core
}

async approveRequest(id, approver?): Promise<{request, item}> {
  const row = this.rowById(id);
  if (!row) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (row.status !== "pending") throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}`);
  const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
  if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用");
  const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
  if (!item) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (item.quantity < row.quantity) throw httpError(409, `库存不足...`);
  const composedReason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
  let updated;
  try {
    updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(row.quantity), composedReason);
  } catch (error) { throw error; }
  // mark approved
  this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET status='approved', decided_at=?, updated_at=?, note=? WHERE id=?`).run(...)
  return { request: this.toRequestView(this.rowById(id)!), item: updated };
}

private beforeStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  const delta = Number(payload?.delta ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta >= 0) return undefined;
  const outbound = Math.abs(Math.trunc(delta));
  let policy: ApprovalPolicy;
  try { policy = this.getPolicy(); } catch { policy = { threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, updatedAt: "" }; }
  if (outbound <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
  const item = payload.item;
  const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
  const approval = rawReason ? this.findApprovalByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
  if (!rawReason) {
    this.recordAudit({ itemId: item.id, itemSku: item.sku, delta, outbound, threshold: policy.threshold, reason: null, outcome: "blocked", source: "direct", approvalId: null, approvalCode: null });
    return `单次出库 ${outbound} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
  }
  this.recordAudit({ ... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null, approvalCode: approval?.code ?? null });
  return undefined;
}

updatePolicy(threshold: number): ApprovalPolicy {
  const value = Math.trunc(threshold);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw httpError(400, "Approval threshold must be a number");
  if (value < MIN_THRESHOLD || value > MAX_THRESHOLD) throw httpError(400, `Approval threshold must be between ${MIN_THRESHOLD} and ${MAX_THRESHOLD}`);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = this.db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM ... WHERE key='threshold'`).get<{key:string}>("threshold");
  if (existing) this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET value=?, updated_at=? WHERE key='threshold'`).run(String(value), now);
  else this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('threshold', ?, ?)`).run(String(value), now);
  return this.getPolicy();
}

interface ApprovalSnapshot { overview: ApprovalOverview | null; loading: boolean; error: string; }
let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>) { snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch }; for (const l of listeners) l(snapshot); }

async function requestJson<T>(url, init?) {...}

async function loadApproval(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ overview: snapshot.overview, loading: false, error: msg });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  await promise;
  inflight = null;
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener); setState(snapshot);
    void loadApproval();
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => loadApproval(true), []);
  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? DEFAULT_POLICY;
  const summary = state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY;
  ...
  return { policy, summary, requests, audit, loading, error, reload };
}

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> { ...same as seeds... }

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try { await promise; } finally { inflight = null; }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY;
  const summary = state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY;
  const requests = state.overview?.requests ?? [];
  const audit = state.overview?.audit ?? [];
  return { policy, summary, requests, audit, loading: state.loading, error: state.error, reload };
}

```ts
function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

function coreInventory(ctx: Context): CoreInventoryService | undefined {
  return (ctx as unknown as { inventory?: CoreInventoryService }).inventory;
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { Context } from "cordis";
import { useNavigate } from "@host/client-sdk";
import type {
  ApprovalAuditEntry,
  ApprovalOverview,
  ApprovalPolicy,
  ApprovalRequestView,
  ApprovalStatus,
  ApprovalSummary,
} from "./contract.d.ts";

interface InventoryItemSummary {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly sku: string;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly quantity: number;
  readonly unit: string;
}

interface InventoryListSlotProps {
  readonly items: readonly InventoryItemSummary[];
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

interface InventoryItemSlotProps {
  readonly item: InventoryItemSummary;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

const EMPTY_POLICY: ApprovalPolicy = { threshold: 50, updatedAt: null };

const EMPTY_SUMMARY: ApprovalSummary = {
  threshold: 50,
  pendingCount: 0,
  approvedCount: 0,
  rejectedCount: 0,
  blockedCount: 0,
  allowedCount: 0,
};

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(init?.headers ?? {}) },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = typeof data.error === "string" && data.error.length > 0 ? data.error : `请求失败 (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return data as T;
}

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try {
    await promise;
  } finally {
    inflight = null;
  }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    void refreshOverview();
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  return {
    policy: state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY,
    summary: state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY,
    requests: state.overview?.requests ?? [],
    audit: state.overview?.audit ?? [],
    loading: state.loading,
    error: state.error,
    reload,
  };
}

    const quantity = Number(row.quantity);
    if (item.quantity < quantity) {

        409,
        `库存不足：${item.sku} 当前 ${item.quantity} 件，申请出库 ${quantity} 件`,
      );
    }
    const reason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;

private guardStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  try {
    const outboundQty = payload.delta < 0 ? Math.abs(Math.trunc(payload.delta)) : 0;
    const policy = this.getPolicy();
    if (outboundQty <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
    const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
    const approval = rawReason ? this.findRequestByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
    if (!rawReason) {
      this.recordAudit({... outcome: "blocked", source: "direct"});
      return `单次出库 ${outboundQty} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
    }
    if (!approval && rawReason.length < MIN_REASON_LENGTH) { ... } // maybe skip
    this.recordAudit({... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null});
    return undefined;
  } catch { return undefined; } // never break core
}

async approveRequest(id, approver?): Promise<{request, item}> {
  const row = this.rowById(id);
  if (!row) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (row.status !== "pending") throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}`);
  const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
  if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用");
  const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
  if (!item) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (item.quantity < row.quantity) throw httpError(409, `库存不足...`);
  const composedReason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
  let updated;
  try {
    updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(row.quantity), composedReason);
  } catch (error) { throw error; }
  // mark approved
  this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET status='approved', decided_at=?, updated_at=?, note=? WHERE id=?`).run(...)
  return { request: this.toRequestView(this.rowById(id)!), item: updated };
}

private beforeStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  const delta = Number(payload?.delta ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta >= 0) return undefined;
  const outbound = Math.abs(Math.trunc(delta));
  let policy: ApprovalPolicy;
  try { policy = this.getPolicy(); } catch { policy = { threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, updatedAt: "" }; }
  if (outbound <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
  const item = payload.item;
  const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
  const approval = rawReason ? this.findApprovalByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
  if (!rawReason) {
    this.recordAudit({ itemId: item.id, itemSku: item.sku, delta, outbound, threshold: policy.threshold, reason: null, outcome: "blocked", source: "direct", approvalId: null, approvalCode: null });
    return `单次出库 ${outbound} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
  }
  this.recordAudit({ ... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null, approvalCode: approval?.code ?? null });
  return undefined;
}

updatePolicy(threshold: number): ApprovalPolicy {
  const value = Math.trunc(threshold);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw httpError(400, "Approval threshold must be a number");
  if (value < MIN_THRESHOLD || value > MAX_THRESHOLD) throw httpError(400, `Approval threshold must be between ${MIN_THRESHOLD} and ${MAX_THRESHOLD}`);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = this.db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM ... WHERE key='threshold'`).get<{key:string}>("threshold");
  if (existing) this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET value=?, updated_at=? WHERE key='threshold'`).run(String(value), now);
  else this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('threshold', ?, ?)`).run(String(value), now);
  return this.getPolicy();
}

async function loadApproval(force = false): Promise<void> {

  })();
  inflight = promise;
  await promise;
  inflight = null;
}

function useApproval() {

    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };

  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? DEFAULT_POLICY;

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> { ...same as seeds... }

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try { await promise; } finally { inflight = null; }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY;
  const summary = state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY;
  const requests = state.overview?.requests ?? [];
  const audit = state.overview?.audit ?? [];
  return { policy, summary, requests, audit, loading: state.loading, error: state.error, reload };
}

function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

function coreInventory(ctx: Context): CoreInventoryService | undefined {

}

  threshold: 50,
  pendingCount: 0,
  approvedCount: 0,
  rejectedCount: 0,
  blockedCount: 0,
  allowedCount: 0,
};

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(init?.headers ?? {}) },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = typeof data.error === "string" && data.error.length > 0 ? data.error : `请求失败 (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return data as T;
}

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try {
    await promise;
  } finally {
    inflight = null;
  }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    void refreshOverview();
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  return {
    policy: state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY,
    summary: state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY,
    requests: state.overview?.requests ?? [],
    audit: state.overview?.audit ?? [],
    loading: state.loading,
    error: state.error,
    reload,
  };
}

function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) {
    return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  }
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

private guardStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  try {
    const outboundQty = payload.delta < 0 ? Math.abs(Math.trunc(payload.delta)) : 0;
    const policy = this.getPolicy();
    if (outboundQty <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
    const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
    const approval = rawReason ? this.findRequestByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
    if (!rawReason) {
      this.recordAudit({... outcome: "blocked", source: "direct"});
      return `单次出库 ${outboundQty} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
    }
    if (!approval && rawReason.length < MIN_REASON_LENGTH) { ... } // maybe skip
    this.recordAudit({... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null});
    return undefined;
  } catch { return undefined; } // never break core
}

async approveRequest(id, approver?): Promise<{request, item}> {
  const row = this.rowById(id);
  if (!row) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (row.status !== "pending") throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}`);
  const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
  if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用");
  const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
  if (!item) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (item.quantity < row.quantity) throw httpError(409, `库存不足...`);
  const composedReason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
  let updated;
  try {
    updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(row.quantity), composedReason);
  } catch (error) { throw error; }
  // mark approved
  this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET status='approved', decided_at=?, updated_at=?, note=? WHERE id=?`).run(...)
  return { request: this.toRequestView(this.rowById(id)!), item: updated };
}

private beforeStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  const delta = Number(payload?.delta ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta >= 0) return undefined;
  const outbound = Math.abs(Math.trunc(delta));
  let policy: ApprovalPolicy;
  try { policy = this.getPolicy(); } catch { policy = { threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, updatedAt: "" }; }
  if (outbound <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
  const item = payload.item;
  const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
  const approval = rawReason ? this.findApprovalByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
  if (!rawReason) {
    this.recordAudit({ itemId: item.id, itemSku: item.sku, delta, outbound, threshold: policy.threshold, reason: null, outcome: "blocked", source: "direct", approvalId: null, approvalCode: null });
    return `单次出库 ${outbound} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
  }
  this.recordAudit({ ... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null, approvalCode: approval?.code ?? null });
  return undefined;
}

updatePolicy(threshold: number): ApprovalPolicy {
  const value = Math.trunc(threshold);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw httpError(400, "Approval threshold must be a number");
  if (value < MIN_THRESHOLD || value > MAX_THRESHOLD) throw httpError(400, `Approval threshold must be between ${MIN_THRESHOLD} and ${MAX_THRESHOLD}`);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = this.db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM ... WHERE key='threshold'`).get<{key:string}>("threshold");
  if (existing) this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET value=?, updated_at=? WHERE key='threshold'`).run(String(value), now);
  else this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('threshold', ?, ?)`).run(String(value), now);
  return this.getPolicy();
}

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> { ...same as seeds... }

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try { await promise; } finally { inflight = null; }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY;
  const summary = state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY;
  const requests = state.overview?.requests ?? [];
  const audit = state.overview?.audit ?? [];
  return { policy, summary, requests, audit, loading: state.loading, error: state.error, reload };
}

```ts
function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

function coreInventory(ctx: Context): CoreInventoryService | undefined {

  threshold: 50,
  pendingCount: 0,
  approvedCount: 0,
  rejectedCount: 0,
  blockedCount: 0,
  allowedCount: 0,
};

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(init?.headers ?? {}) },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = typeof data.error === "string" && data.error.length > 0 ? data.error : `请求失败 (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return data as T;
}

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try {
    await promise;
  } finally {
    inflight = null;
  }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    void refreshOverview();
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  return {
    policy: state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY,
    summary: state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY,
    requests: state.overview?.requests ?? [],
    audit: state.overview?.audit ?? [],
    loading: state.loading,
    error: state.error,
    reload,
  };
}

function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return {
    status,
    body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) },
  };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) {
    return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  }
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

private guardStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  try {
    const outboundQty = payload.delta < 0 ? Math.abs(Math.trunc(payload.delta)) : 0;
    const policy = this.getPolicy();
    if (outboundQty <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
    const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
    const approval = rawReason ? this.findRequestByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
    if (!rawReason) {
      this.recordAudit({... outcome: "blocked", source: "direct"});
      return `单次出库 ${outboundQty} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
    }
    if (!approval && rawReason.length < MIN_REASON_LENGTH) { ... } // maybe skip
    this.recordAudit({... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null});
    return undefined;
  } catch { return undefined; } // never break core
}
```

async approveRequest(id, approver?): Promise<{request, item}> {
  const row = this.rowById(id);
  if (!row) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (row.status !== "pending") throw httpError(409, `审批单 ${row.code} 当前状态为 ${row.status}`);
  const inventory = coreInventory(this.ctx);
  if (!inventory) throw httpError(503, "库存服务不可用");
  const item = inventory.get(row.item_id);
  if (!item) throw httpError(404, ...);
  if (item.quantity < row.quantity) throw httpError(409, `库存不足...`);
  const composedReason = `[审批 ${row.code}] ${row.reason}`;
  let updated;
  try {
    updated = await inventory.adjustStock(row.item_id, -Math.abs(row.quantity), composedReason);
  } catch (error) { throw error; }
  // mark approved
  this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET status='approved', decided_at=?, updated_at=?, note=? WHERE id=?`).run(...)
  return { request: this.toRequestView(this.rowById(id)!), item: updated };
}
```

private beforeStockChange(payload: BeforeStockChangePayload): string | undefined {
  const delta = Number(payload?.delta ?? 0);
  if (!Number.isFinite(delta) || delta >= 0) return undefined;
  const outbound = Math.abs(Math.trunc(delta));
  let policy: ApprovalPolicy;
  try { policy = this.getPolicy(); } catch { policy = { threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD, updatedAt: "" }; }
  if (outbound <= policy.threshold) return undefined;
  const item = payload.item;
  const rawReason = typeof payload.reason === "string" ? payload.reason.trim() : "";
  const approval = rawReason ? this.findApprovalByReason(rawReason) : undefined;
  if (!rawReason) {
    this.recordAudit({ itemId: item.id, itemSku: item.sku, delta, outbound, threshold: policy.threshold, reason: null, outcome: "blocked", source: "direct", approvalId: null, approvalCode: null });
    return `单次出库 ${outbound} 件超过审批阈值 ${policy.threshold} 件，请填写审批理由后重试`;
  }
  this.recordAudit({ ... outcome: "allowed", source: approval ? "approval" : "direct", approvalId: approval?.id ?? null, approvalCode: approval?.code ?? null });
  return undefined;
}

updatePolicy(threshold: number): ApprovalPolicy {
  const value = Math.trunc(threshold);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw httpError(400, "Approval threshold must be a number");
  if (value < MIN_THRESHOLD || value > MAX_THRESHOLD) throw httpError(400, `Approval threshold must be between ${MIN_THRESHOLD} and ${MAX_THRESHOLD}`);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = this.db.prepare(`SELECT key FROM ... WHERE key='threshold'`).get<{key:string}>("threshold");
  if (existing) this.db.prepare(`UPDATE ... SET value=?, updated_at=? WHERE key='threshold'`).run(String(value), now);
  else this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('threshold', ?, ?)`).run(String(value), now);
  return this.getPolicy();
}

  await promise;
  inflight = null;

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> { ...same as seeds... }

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try { await promise; } finally { inflight = null; }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    return () => { listeners.delete(listener); };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  const policy = state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY;
  const summary = state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY;
  const requests = state.overview?.requests ?? [];
  const audit = state.overview?.audit ?? [];
  return { policy, summary, requests, audit, loading: state.loading, error: state.error, reload };
}

```ts
function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return { status, body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) } };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}

function coreInventory(ctx: Context): CoreInventoryService | undefined {
  return (ctx as unknown as { inventory?: CoreInventoryService }).inventory;

import type {

interface InventoryItemSummary {

  readonly name: string;

  readonly unit: string;

  readonly items: readonly InventoryItemSummary[];
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

interface InventoryItemSlotProps {
  readonly item: InventoryItemSummary;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

const EMPTY_POLICY: ApprovalPolicy = { threshold: 50, updatedAt: null };

const EMPTY_SUMMARY: ApprovalSummary = {
  threshold: 50,
  pendingCount: 0,
  approvedCount: 0,
  rejectedCount: 0,
  blockedCount: 0,
  allowedCount: 0,
};

interface ApprovalSnapshot {
  readonly overview: ApprovalOverview | null;
  readonly loading: boolean;
  readonly error: string;
}

let snapshot: ApprovalSnapshot = { overview: null, loading: false, error: "" };
const listeners = new Set<(next: ApprovalSnapshot) => void>();
let inflight: Promise<void> | null = null;

function publish(patch: Partial<ApprovalSnapshot>): void {
  snapshot = { ...snapshot, ...patch };
  for (const listener of listeners) listener(snapshot);
}

async function requestJson<T>(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    ...init,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(init?.headers ?? {}) },
  });
  const text = await response.text();
  const data: Record<string, unknown> = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = typeof data.error === "string" && data.error.length > 0 ? data.error : `请求失败 (${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(message);
  }
  return data as T;
}

async function refreshOverview(force = false): Promise<void> {
  if (inflight) return inflight;
  if (!force && snapshot.overview) return;
  const promise = (async () => {
    publish({ loading: true });
    try {
      const overview = await requestJson<ApprovalOverview>("/api/app/inventory-approval/overview");
      publish({ overview, loading: false, error: "" });
    } catch (err) {
      publish({ loading: false, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    }
  })();
  inflight = promise;
  try {
    await promise;
  } finally {
    inflight = null;
  }
}

function useApproval() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ApprovalSnapshot>(snapshot);
  useEffect(() => {
    const listener = (next: ApprovalSnapshot) => setState(next);
    listeners.add(listener);
    setState(snapshot);
    void refreshOverview();
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }, []);
  const reload = useCallback(() => refreshOverview(true), []);
  return {
    policy: state.overview?.policy ?? EMPTY_POLICY,
    summary: state.overview?.summary ?? EMPTY_SUMMARY,
    requests: state.overview?.requests ?? [],
    audit: state.overview?.audit ?? [],
    loading: state.loading,
    error: state.error,
    reload,
  };
}

function httpError(status: number, message: string): Error & { status: number } {
  const error = new Error(message) as Error & { status: number };
  error.status = status;
  return error;
}

function toErrorResponse(error: unknown): { status: number; body: { error: string } } {
  const status =
    typeof (error as { status?: unknown })?.status === "number"
      ? (error as { status: number }).status
      : 400;
  return {
    status,
    body: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) },
  };
}

function makeId(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
}

function clampThreshold(value: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return DEFAULT_THRESHOLD;
  return Math.min(MAX_THRESHOLD, Math.max(MIN_THRESHOLD, Math.trunc(value)));
}

function readLimit(raw: string | undefined): number {
  if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.trim().length === 0) {
    return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  }
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) return DEFAULT_AUDIT_LIMIT;
  return Math.min(Math.max(1, parsed), MAX_AUDIT_LIMIT);
}
